import sys,json
sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8')
from pywinauto import Desktop
keys=('gemini','threads','傳送','貼文','下載','訊息','prompt','post','send','download','text')
rows=[]
for w in Desktop(backend='uia').windows():
    title=(w.window_text() or '')
    if 'Edge' not in title and 'Gemini' not in title and 'Threads' not in title:
        continue
    for c in w.descendants(control_type='Button') + w.descendants(control_type='Edit') + w.descendants(control_type='Document') + w.descendants(control_type='Text'):
        txt=(c.window_text() or '').strip()
        aid=str(getattr(c.element_info,'automation_id','') or '')
        blob=(txt+' '+aid).lower()
        if any(k in blob for k in keys):
            rows.append({'window':title[:140],'text':txt[:180],'type':getattr(c.element_info,'control_type',None),'automation_id':aid[:140]})
print(json.dumps(rows[:180],ensure_ascii=False))
